about: Exercise copy of the immutable criteria snapshot an admin publishes from the admin screens. Every value below is configuration, not code.

licence_holder.definition: Who holds the Ontario electrical contractor licence for this work: the bidding company itself, a third party such as a subcontractor, or nobody.

wsib_clearance.definition: The proposal states that the bidder has current WSIB clearance.

liability_insurance_cad.definition: Liability insurance coverage amount the bidder states it carries.

total_price_cad.definition: Total contract price stated for the whole project.

completion_weeks.definition: Committed time from contract award to a complete system.

qualifying_project_count.definition: Number of completed commercial solar installations of at least 100 kW the bidder claims.

project_period.definition: The period those projects are said to fall within, as stated (for example since a year, or within the last N years).

panel_warranty_years.definition: Length of the panel (product) warranty offered.

workmanship_warranty_years.definition: Length of the bidder's own workmanship (installation) warranty.

named_project_lead.definition: A specific person is identified as project lead or project manager.

crew_size.definition: Number of people in the dedicated installation crew.

safety_plan.definition: A site safety plan is included.

performance_monitoring.definition: Post-installation system performance monitoring is offered. Project progress reporting alone does not count.

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by the bidder
